/*common.coco.selectCommonCoCoBuyerCurrencyPop*/
SELECT DT.EXP_CODE ,HD.EXP_CUR ,DECODE(HD.EXP_PRICE_FLAG,'S','매출','P','매입') AS EXP_PRICE_NM ,HD.EXP_CUR_PRICE ,DT.BUYER ,DT.BUYER_ITEM_NO ,DT.CONTRACT_NO ,DT.CONTRACT_SEQ ,DT.STATUS ,DT.EXP_FOR_UNIT_PRICE ,DT.EXP_KR_UNIT_PRICE ,DT.EXP_INC_EXPENSE ,DT.ADD_USER_ID , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = DT.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_NM ,DT.ADD_DATE ,DT.ADD_TIME ,DT.CHANGE_USER_ID , (SELECT USR.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID = DT.CHANGE_USER_ID) AS CHANGE_USER_NM ,DT.CHANGE_DATE ,DT.CHANGE_TIME ,HD.ADD_DATE AS CURRENCY_ADD_DATE ,HD.CHANGE_DATE AS CURRENCY_CHANGE_DATE FROM KEP_CURRENCY_HD HD, KEP_CURRENCY_DT DT WHERE HD.EXP_CODE = DT.EXP_CODE AND DT.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND DT.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND DT.CONTRACT_NO = #{st_contract_no} AND DT.CONTRACT_SEQ = #{st_contract_seq} AND DT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = #{st_buyer_item_no}

/*selectExpInfo*/ SELECT
(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRISUC0005') IRS_NAME , (SELECT CEO_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRISUC0005') CEO_NAME_LOC , (SELECT INDUSTRY_TYPE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRISUC0005') INDUSTRY_TYPE , (SELECT BUSINESS_ITEMS FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRISUC0005') BUSINESS_ITEMS , (SELECT ADDRESS_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRISUC0005') ADDRESS_LOC
(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRCOWA0001') IRS_NAME , (SELECT CEO_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRCOWA0001') CEO_NAME_LOC , (SELECT INDUSTRY_TYPE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRCOWA0001') INDUSTRY_TYPE , (SELECT BUSINESS_ITEMS FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRCOWA0001') BUSINESS_ITEMS , (SELECT ADDRESS_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRCOWA0001') ADDRESS_LOC
DECODE(IR.IRS_NO,NULL,CM.COM_NAME_LOC,IR.IRS_NAME) IRS_NAME , DECODE(IR.IRS_NO,NULL,CM.CEO_NAME_LOC,IR.CEO_NAME_LOC) CEO_NAME_LOC , DECODE(IR.IRS_NO,NULL,CM.INDUSTRY_TYPE,IR.INDUSTRY_TYPE) INDUSTRY_TYPE , DECODE(IR.IRS_NO,NULL,CM.BUSINESS_ITEMS,IR.BUSINESS_ITEMS) BUSINESS_ITEMS , DECODE(IR.IRS_NO,NULL,CM.ADDRESS_LOC,IR.ADDRESS_LOC) ADDRESS_LOC
FROM KEPTIRSN IR /* 고객사 사업자정보 */ , V_VOC_ICOMCMPY CM /* (ICOMCMPY - 회원사정보, MIS_BUYER_MNG - 고객사별 담당자 정보), KEPMDCP02@kepcon(주석처리됨) */ WHERE 1=1 AND CM.SYS_TYPE IN ('KA', 'KK') AND IR.IRS_NO(+) = #{irs_no} AND CM.SYS_TYPE = IR.SITE(+) AND CM.COM_CODE = IR.COM_CODE(+) AND LPAD(CM.COM_CODE , 10, 0) = LPAD(#{com_code}, 10, 0) AND CM.BUSINESS_COND <> 'S'
